tools.name: describe_body
tools.description: Return this physical body's hardware, binding, online state, current expression, and dock status. Use this before promising an action.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Return connection, tracking, expression, and the last motion acknowledgement.

tools.name: set_expression
tools.description: Morph the on-screen Orb face to one expression from the body's expression list.

tools.name: control_dock
tools.description: Move the DockKit stand. Spoken commands on the phone already turn the stand locally; only use this tool for requests typed in this chat. Do not tell the user it finished until this tool returns succeeded.

tools.name: set_tracking
tools.description: Enable or disable DockKit face/person tracking. Tracking is on by default when the phone is docked. Spoken 跟着我 / 别跟着 on the phone already toggle it locally.

tools.name: get_frame
tools.description: Capture one compressed JPEG from the phone camera. The image leaves the phone through this cloud for this call only.

tools.name: record_video
tools.description: Record a short MP4 from the phone camera and microphone, 1 to 12 seconds. Returns a URL. Do not say recording finished until this returns ok.

tools.name: wait_for_speech
tools.description: Wait until the person in front of the phone says something. Returns heard=true and the transcript, or heard=false if they stay silent. When heard=true, write that transcript into this chat so the conversation is visible, then reply and speak. Do not invent speech. Default 18s, max 22s. Always call this again immediately, including after heard=false, after speak, and after other body tools.

tools.name: set_wake_hook
tools.description: Register an HTTPS webhook. When the person speaks and you are not in wait_for_speech, the body POSTs JSON {event,text} so you wake. Create a webhook routine first, then pass its URL. After waking, speak your reply and wait_for_speech for the next sentence.

input.secret: optional sender key or Standard Webhooks whsec_ secret

tools.name: speak
tools.description: Say one short sentence on the phone speaker, such as a task-done line. Long answers belong in the chat, not here. The phone uses a Grok voice only if the owner saved their own xAI key; otherwise the system voice. Do not tell the user you spoke until the tool returns ok.
